Build per-pcgroup purity summary for the over-grouping scatter plot

Source: R/CAMERA_evaluation_functions.R
build_plot2_data.Rd

Extracts neutral masses from CAMERA's adduct annotation column for every feature, then summarises per pcgroup: how many distinct neutral masses were assigned by CAMERA within that pcgroup, and what is the median RT. The result is the plot2_data object consumed by the plot-over-grouping chunk in CAMERA_evaluation_analysis.Rmd.

CAMERA writes adduct annotations as e.g. "[M+H]+ 194.057909" or "[M+Na]+ 194.057909; [M+K]+ 194.057909". This function extracts the trailing numeric mass (the last decimal number on each semicolon- delimited entry), rounds to 4 dp to absorb floating point noise, and counts distinct values per pcgroup.

Usage

build_plot2_data(CAMERA_ft, mass_digits = 4L)

Arguments

CAMERA_ft

data.frame. CAMERA-annotated feature table. Must contain: pcgroup, rt, and a CAMERA adduct column. The adduct column is detected automatically: the first column whose name matches adduct (case-insensitive) is used, falling back to a column named CAMERA_adduct. Rows with missing or empty adduct strings are excluded.

mass_digits

integer(1). Number of decimal places used when rounding neutral masses before counting distinct values. Default 4.

Value

A data.frame with one row per pcgroup (those with at least one CAMERA adduct annotation), containing:

pcgroup

CAMERA pcgroup identifier.

median_rt

Median RT (seconds) of all features in the pcgroup.

n_distinct_neutralM

Number of distinct neutral masses found within the pcgroup.

grouping_class

Ordered factor: "1 neutral mass", "2 neutral masses", "3-5 neutral masses", ">5 neutral masses".
